name: jumplist
description: Read a jump list. automaticDestinations-ms (an OLE compound file): the DestList entries by their version's layout (1, 3 and 4; any other version is refused with a problem and no entries): entry number, NetBIOS host name, last access (raw FILETIME and ISO 8601 UTC, seven fractional digits), pin state and target path, with the access counters returned raw as undecoded_* and no access count claimed; and every embedded link structure written to out_dir for lnk_parse (the path, the volume serial and the target timestamps are the link's, not the DestList's). customDestinations-ms has no container: its link structures are CARVED by their 20-byte header, each marked carved, and the container is not parsed. Entries, links and files are paged: `limit` is the inline page size, and every row is kept in the file the page names. status is complete, partial or failed; the exit status is 1 only when no file could be read. SENSITIVE: the links inside a jump list carry arguments and working directories that can hold a command line with a secret; run it as a job with secret_output: true when they may.

path.description: A .automaticDestinations-ms or .customDestinations-ms file, or a directory of them

out_dir.description: Write each embedded link structure here, under work/, for lnk_parse to read; a path outside the run directory or under inputs/ is refused

limit.description: Entries, link structures and files shown inline per file (default 500, an inline page size); every one is read, every link is written to out_dir, and when there are more the whole list is written as JSON Lines and named in the page's all_results
